_why: Excalibur Con publishes its programming in TWO places. The Eventeny schedule endpoint (source
'Excalibur Con') carries the 102 panel/TTRPG sessions. The tournaments, demos and meet-ups on
this page are NOT in that endpoint and are reachable no other way — the host exposes no feed,
no JSON-LD and no ?format=json, and the page is hand-written prose, so a scraper would be
parsing sentences. Hand transcription is the honest method here, and the confidence tier says so.
_dateCorrection: EVERY date on the source page is one year stale: it writes 'Saturday August 16' and 'Sunday
August 17', which were the 2025 weekdays. In 2026 the convention runs Saturday 2026-08-15 and
Sunday 2026-08-16, and the page's own copyright reads 2026.
The WEEKDAY is what the page gets right, so every event below is dated from its weekday.
Corroborated against the authoritative Eventeny feed: this page lists the Artemis simulator as
'Saturday August 16 ... Gooseberry Room 3' and Eventeny has Artemis Experience hourly on
Saturday 2026-08-15 in Gooseberry 3 — same event, same room, one year off on the date.
RE-VERIFY THIS on the next pull; if the publisher fixes its dates, drop the shift, do not

_omitted.Artemis Spaceship Bridge Simulator: Already ingested from Eventeny as 'Artemis Experience' (hourly, Gooseberry 3). Re-adding it here would publish a second copy at a conflicting start time (this page says 11:00 on the hour, Eventeny says 11:30), and dedupe cannot merge across that gap. The authoritative feed wins.
_omitted.Official Excalibur Con Cosplay Contest: Eventeny already publishes the cosplay programming under its 'Cosplay Event' track, with real times. This page states no times.

events.title: Star Wars Unlimited Constructed Tournament
events.description: Star Wars Unlimited Constructed tournament. 8 people minimum, 16 people max. 3 rounds of Swiss, cut to top 4. 1st place sealed box.

events.title: Disney Lorcana Tournament & Learn to Play
events.description: Constructed 60 card decks. 5 rounds of Swiss, no cut to top. Pack per round win, sealed box to first place. 30 player cap. Learn to play runs throughout the day in the Level Up Gaming Pavilion.

events.description: Official single elimination, pack crack format. Ward is a locally developed TCG; the booth also runs demos, mini tournaments and giveaways throughout the weekend.

events.description: Taught by local miniature artist Elle Firespray. Limited to 25 participants; sign up early. Bring number 2 brushes if possible — brushes provided if needed. Miniatures, paints and supplies provided by Hobby Town Hermantown.

events.title: Harry Potter Meet-Up
events.description: Wand making, spell-casting and a side quest with the Marauder's Map, plus a chance to win an exclusive Excalibur Con wand created by Wands of May. Invitation only — watch for your Owl Post letter.

events.title: Dylan's Drink and Draw
events.description: Comic artist Dylan Jacobson hosts his Drink & Draw, featuring local artists. No artistic ability needed. Cash bar. Space is limited, first come first served. NOTE: this one is OFF-SITE at the Radisson, not at the DECC.

events.title: Disney Princess Tea Party
events.description: Meet Disney princesses, learn to paint with tea, and learn Lorcana. The publisher states no start time — this is an all-day placeholder, so check the on-site schedule.

events.title: Dwarven Axe Miniature Painting Competition
events.description: Miniature painting competition running the weekend. Cost of entry is an event badge (day or weekend) — no separate fee. Trophies for best in show and first place in each category; placement coins for all entries. One entry per category per person — categories at https://www.dwarvenaxe.com/categories. Interviews and entry videos stream at https://twitch.tv/dwarvenaxepainting. The publisher states no start time.

events.title: Hobby Town Model Painting Contest
events.description: Bring your best models in person to enter, or use the QR code to enter online. Prizes provided by Hobby Town. Runs all weekend; the publisher states no start time.

events.title: RPG Gameplay and Demos
events.description: RPG demos and one-shots throughout the weekend, from classic Dungeons & Dragons one-shots by local Dungeon Masters to more niche games, for all ages and abilities. A local DM runs demos through the day Saturday to introduce players to D&D — aimed at youth, but open to anyone. Sign up at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1xSRtkIWJhd348autYL6izUES0WlBXp0A1c56JPw377Q/viewform. The publisher states no per-session times.

events.title: Teeb Player Events & Side Quest
events.room: Exhibit hall, community area and Level Up Gaming Pavilion
events.description: Contests, art activities, giveaways and SWAG trading at no cost, plus a special side quest sponsored by Teeb Players with an exclusive ribbon for completing it. The publisher states no start time.
